hook_text: R34 567 plus R9 998 in your head in three seconds. Here is the trick.
clip_script: Book fair in East London. R34 567 in sales, plus R9 998 in orders. Columns? Four carries. Trick: 9 998 is nearly 10 000. Add 10 000: 44 567. You added 2 too many. Take 2 off: R44 565. Now the fundraiser. Target R42 000, raised R38 750. How much more? Count up. Jump 250 to 39 000. Jump 3 000 to 42 000. Add the jumps: R3 250. Check the opposite way: 38 750 plus 3 250 is 42 000. Spot on. Round and fix, jump and add, then check a different way.
visual_style: A price total morphing from 9 998 into 10 000 with a small minus 2 tag, then frogs jumping along a number line.
mood: Quick and satisfying, like a mental maths race.
pacing: The rounding trick fast, the number line jumps steady, the check as the final click.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out 25 678 plus 19 999 with the trick.
